privacy_and_outcome_coverage.otp_and_session: Genuine SQLite/WebCrypto tests cover bound codes, guessing budgets, original verification/rotation keys, refresh reuse, disabled accounts, club revisions and same-database commit-time guards.
privacy_and_outcome_coverage.lease_retry: Atomic journal/lease controls, adoption quarantine, late responses, lease loss and receipt replay preserve unknown outcomes and never authorize a second external provider POST for the same claim.
privacy_and_outcome_coverage.provider_boundary: All network/provider tests use synthetic fetchers and receipts. Accepted provider message is not handset receipt or authentication. No live provider call executed.
privacy_and_outcome_coverage.redaction: Native public errors and provider/SQL errors are sanitized. Code/phone ciphertexts and purpose-separated HMAC/hash commitments remain private linkable data with retention gates. Nine deployment bypass regressions and two body-deadline regressions have before/after proof.
privacy_and_outcome_coverage.private_capabilities: Verifier, browser identity, queue health, private sender and private receipt readers expose HTTP404. Direct native routes require configured HTTPS origin, native marker, trusted CF context and limiter; native marker alone is not authentication.
